The Minecraft painting “Prairie Ride” by Sarah Boeving is based off of the painting “The Cowboy”, by Frederic Remington (1902):{img #location-orig#Remington_The_Cowboy_1902.jpg}{img #location#prairie_ride.png}

The Minecraft painting “Bonjour Monsieur Courbet” by Kristoffer Zetterstrand is based off of the painting “The Meeting”, by Gustave Courbet (1854):{img #location-orig#Gustave_Courbet_-_Bonjour_Monsieur_Courbet_-_Musée_Fabre.jpg}{img #location#courbet.png}

The Minecraft painting “Humble” by Sarah Boeving is based off of the painting “American Gothic”, by Grant Wood (1930):{img #location-orig#Grant_Wood_-_American_Gothic_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg}{img #location#humble.png}

The Minecraft painting “Backyard” by Kristoffer Zetterstrand is based off of the painting “The Courtyard of a House in Delft”, by Pieter de Hooch (1658):{img #location-orig#The_Courtyard_of_a_House_in_Delft.jpg}{img #location#backyard.png}

The Minecraft painting “Fighters” by Kristoffer Zetterstrand is based off of the painting “Indian Summer, Vermont”, by Willard Metcalf (1922):{img #location-orig#Willard_Leroy_Metcalf_-_Indian_Summer,_Vermont_-_1973.83_-_Dallas_Museum_of_Art.jpg}{img #location#fighters.png}
